test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The price of a bike is ₹75,500. What will be the price of the bike after a reduction of 17%?
solution:
**Given:**

Price of bike = Rs 75,500

Reduction Percentage = 17%

**Concept Used:**

Price After Reduction = Original Price – Percentage of Original Price

**Calculation:**

Price after reduction = 75500 – 17% of 17500

Price after reduction = 75500-(17)/(100)times 75500=75500-17×755

Price after reduction = 75500 – 12835 = Rs 62,665.

**∴ The price of a bike after a reduction of 17% is Rs 62,665.**
